title: Senior Node.js Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to take ownership of production applications and build scalable web solutions across backend, frontend, database, and cloud environments.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Design and develop scalable web applications and backend services using Node.js and TypeScript
  • Build REST or GraphQL APIs with NestJS or similar frameworks
  • Develop modern frontend applications using React or Next.js
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL database models and queries
  • Integrate third-party services and enterprise systems
  • Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
  • Participate in architecture and technical-planning discussions

  • Take ownership of development tasks and delivery

     

Requirements

 

  • 5+ years of professional software-development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Experience with NestJS or similar backend frameworks
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, and relational database design
  • Strong experience with React, Next.js, or similar frontend frameworks
  • Experience with Docker, cloud deployment, and CI/CD
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and modern web application architecture
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of delivery

  • Professional English

     

Nice to have

 

  • AWS or Azure
  • Kubernetes and Terraform
  • Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event-driven technologies
  • Microservices and enterprise integrations
  • GraphQL
  • AI/LLM integration experience
  • Experience in FinTech, banking, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated domains

 

This is an application to join CML Team. Selected engineers will be contacted when a suitable project matches their experience, availability, location, and rate.

 

To apply: Please include your CV, current location, availability, preferred contract type, and expected hourly or daily rate.
